notes: League is the 'Stoiximan Super League' (season 22 Aug 2026 - 23 May 2027). Domestic TV rights are sold club by club, and each broadcaster shows its clubs' home games. Cosmote TV / Cosmote Sport (OTE) was renamed Magenta TV / Magenta Sport in 2026. For 2026-27 Panathinaikos and Iraklis home games moved to the new Skai Group / Alafouzos platform ΣΠΟΡ FM TV (Sport FM TV). Panathinaikos was with Cosmote in 2025-26. Wikipedia's club table lists 'Skai TV' (free-to-air) for these two clubs, but sport-fm.gr's 2026-27 listings show the matches on ΣΠΟΡ FM TV 1, so ΣΠΟΡ FM TV is used here. Whether ΣΠΟΡ FM TV is free or subscription could not be confirmed. Gaps: no confirmed 2026-27 foreign broadcasters were found. Wikipedia's claim of Eurosport pan-European rights is unreferenced and looks outdated. Its Coupang Play (South Korea, Olympiacos matches) claim is marked citation needed. TrillerTV carried the 2024-25 play-offs in UK & Ireland, France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Scandinavia, but no 2026-27 confirmation was found. All were left out. A web search quota limit stopped further international research.
